title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups.

**Our Culture**
---------------

**Who we are:**

Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500.

**How we work:**

* **We move Blitzy Fast:** Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
* **Championship Mindset:** We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
* **Passion for Invention:** We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
* **We Work for the Customer:** We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed Senior QA Engineer to join our team and help ensure our AI platform delivers enterprise-grade reliability and exceptional user experience. You'll be a hands-on individual contributor, spending the majority of your time crafting thorough test cases and executing manual testing across web and mobile applications. Working directly alongside our founding designer and engineering teams, you'll be on the front lines of quality for one of the most technically ambitious products being built today.

This is not a maintenance role at a legacy company. You'll be testing software that writes software -validating the output of an autonomous AI platform used by Fortune 500 enterprises. The problems you'll encounter are novel, the pace is fast, and the quality bar is high. As an IC, you'll have direct influence over how quality is practiced at a company building one of the most ambitious products in enterprise AI today. Your work will be seen, felt, and valued from day one.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define comprehensive manual test cases for new features based on UX designs, requirements, and user workflows.
* Own regression testing across web and mobile applications to ensure existing functionality remains intact across releases.
* Lead exploratory testing to identify edge cases, failure points, and potential issues before they reach customers.
* Execute API testing to validate front-end and back-end integrations and ensure reliable system functionality.
* Ensure thorough end-to-end test coverage across critical user journeys and application experiences.
* Manage defects tracking in Jira through accurate documentation, prioritization, and assignment
* Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and design teams to align on requirements and quality standards.
* Partner with the Automation Engineer to identify opportunities to automate repetitive manual tests and improve testing efficiency.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 6+ years of QA experience with a strong emphasis on manual testing.
* Expert-level manual testing skills across web and mobile applications.
* Deep understanding of UX design principles and requirements analysis.
* Experience with API testing and integration testing.
* Strong knowledge of test case design, execution, and management.
* Hands-on experience with bug tracking tools (Jira preferred).
* Experience working within Scrum or Kanban methodologies.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
* Strong attention to detail with a user-focused mindset.
* Track record of implementing QA best practices from scratch in a fast-moving environment.

*Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process*

title: Senior Security QA Engineer, Cloud
description:

title: Assistant Manager - Quality Assurance
description:
**Job Title**

Sanitarian - Taloja

  

**Segment / Business Unit**

Mars Snacking

  

**Country / Site**

Taloja

  

**Job Function**

Supply

  

**Expected Job Level**

T1

  

**Manager’s Name & Position**

Value Stream Manager - Taloja

  

**Job Purpose/Overview**

  

The Sanitarian safeguards food safety and product quality at our Taloja cereal manufacturing site by leading robust sanitation, hygiene, pest management and environmental monitoring programs. The role partners across the plant to strengthen compliance, prevent risk and continuously improve sanitation performance in line with GMP, HACCP, FSSC 22000/ISO 22000, regulatory and Mars Snacking standards.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Sanitation Program Leadership**

* Lead and continuously improve sanitation programs across production, processing, storage, packaging and plant infrastructure areas.
* Own the Master Sanitation Schedule, ensuring daily, weekly and monthly activities are completed, verified and followed through with clear corrective actions.
* Plan plant thermal fogging and raw-material fumigation effectiveness checks, and ensure actions are completed to the required standard.
* Conduct daily GEMBA walks and regular program-effectiveness checks, using observations and data to strengthen standards and operational discipline.
  

**Food Safety, Monitoring and Compliance**

* Plan and execute the environmental monitoring program, including cross-functional alignment, sampling, trend review and closure of non-compliances.
* Lead planned verification and validation activities, including annual pathogen verification, allergen validation and APC validation for production lines.
* Ensure compliance with GMP, HACCP, FSMA, FSSC 22000, ISO 22000, regulatory requirements and Mars Snacking food safety standards.
* Plan and coordinate water, steam and compressed-air testing with laboratories, ensuring samples are collected and analysed within agreed timelines.
* Maintain accurate sanitation records, cleaning schedules, verification evidence and regulatory documentation, ensuring audit readiness at all times.
  

**Pest, Supplier and External Partner Management**

* Coordinate the plant pest management program with external service providers, monitor trends and thresholds, and drive timely action on internal or external sightings.
* Partner with suppliers and vendors to strengthen hygiene and infestation controls, including site visits, performance reviews and timely portal updates.
* Play an active role in internal, external, customer and regulatory audits and assessments, including the annual Regional/Internal Sanitation Gap Assessment.
  

**Risk Management and Continuous Improvement**

* Investigate sanitation-related non-conformances and customer complaints, complete robust root-cause analysis, and implement effective CAPA.
* Partner with cross-functional teams on Management of Change, food safety risk assessments, hygienic design reviews and cleaning standards for new or existing equipment.
* Compile and communicate weekly and monthly sanitation, raw and packaging material, quality and food safety KPIs, translating insights into practical improvement plans.
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance food safety, sanitation effectiveness and operational efficiency.
  

**Capability, Collaboration and Resource Management**

* Build sanitation capability across the site by training associates on SSOPs, personal and plant hygiene, allergen control, environmental monitoring and the Master Sanitation Program.
* Manage the plant Quality and Food Safety budget and maintain appropriate inventories of swabs, equipment and housekeeping chemicals.
* Contribute to regional and global sanitation Communities of Expertise and support other plant CoE priorities as allocated.

  

**Context and Scope**

  

This is a hands-on, site-based role that combines technical sanitation expertise with strong cross-functional influence. The role works closely with the Plant Management Team, Quality & Food Safety, Operations, Engineering, Procurement, laboratories, suppliers, service partners and site associates to translate standards into consistent day-to-day execution.

Success requires visible leadership on the shop floor, disciplined follow-through, confident challenge when standards are at risk, and the ability to turn audit, monitoring and performance data into sustainable improvements.

  

**Job Specifications****/Qualifications**

  

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Microbiology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or a related discipline.
* 7-12 years of experience in sanitation or food safety within a food manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of cereal processing operations and food safety management systems is preferred.

  

**Knowledge / Experience**

* Strong knowledge of GMP, HACCP, FSSC 22000/ISO 22000, sanitation verification and validation, environmental monitoring, allergen control and pest management.
* Practical understanding of cleaning chemicals, CIP/COP systems, SSOP development and hygienic equipment design.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate non-conformances, lead root-cause analysis and CAPA, and interpret sanitation and microbiological data.
* Experience coordinating audits, laboratories, suppliers and external service providers in a complex manufacturing environment.
* Strong planning, stakeholder management, communication and training skills, with confidence influencing cross-functional teams.
* Comfort working in a plant environment and spending significant time on the shop floor, including routine GEMBA walks and sanitation-effectiveness checks.

**About The Company**

Power Financial Wellness is a fast-growing financial wellness fintech platform committed to improving the financial health of workers across Africa. We partner with employers, gig platforms, banks, lenders and SACCOs to deliver a holistic suite of financial services including earned wage access, savings and investment options, credit and loans, and insurance directly to employees and underserved workers.  
  
Our mission is to empower individuals to live with dignity and control over their financial lives, reduce financial stress and unlock better financial outcomes. We achieve this by embedding tailored financial tools and support into the workplace, creating solutions that are affordable, accessible, and easy to use.  
  
Founded in Nairobi and backed by venture capital, Power is scaling rapidly across sub-Saharan Africa and beyond, striving to make financial wellness a reality for all workers whether in formal employment or the informal economy.

**Role Summary**

The QA Engineer is the operational owner of day-to-day QA execution for Power, ensuring releases meet agreed quality standards with minimal supervision. The role coordinates regression testing, environment readiness, defect follow-up, and QA sign-off while expanding automation across critical user journeys. Working with the Quality Lead, Business Analysts, and development teams, the Senior QA Engineer maintains requirements traceability, mentors junior QA engineers, and reports quality metrics. The role ensures testing continues reliably when senior team members are engaged in client work.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Release QA Ownership**

* Operationally own QA execution for each release, including test scope, regression sequencing, task allocation, and progress tracking.
* Confirm environment readiness, test data, access, and build availability before testing; coordinate resolution of blockers.
* Execute and coordinate functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing across critical workflows.
* Coordinate defect triage, retesting, and closure with development teams, and escalate unresolved release risks promptly.
* Consolidate test results, outstanding defects, and quality risks to coordinate QA sign-off with the designated approvers.

**Test Automation and Continuous Improvement**

* Build, maintain, and improve automated tests across critical user journeys, prioritising business risk and repeatable regression scenarios.
* Continuously expand automation coverage and improve test reliability, maintainability, and execution efficiency.
* Investigate automated test failures, address unreliable tests, and distinguish product defects from test or environment issues.

**Requirements Traceability and Test Case Management**

* Partner with Business Analysts to clarify acceptance criteria and ensure test coverage and traceability for every Functional Requirements Document (FRD).\
* Maintain and manage the test case repository, keeping cases current, reusable, prioritised, and linked to requirements and execution results.
* Review test coverage when requirements change and identify gaps before release testing begins.

**Mentoring and Quality Reporting**

* Mentor junior QA engineers through task allocation, practical guidance, and review of test cases, defect reports, automation, and execution outputs.
* Balance testing priorities and team capacity, escalating delivery risks or resource constraints to the Quality Lead.
* Report defect escape rate, regression cycle time, and automation coverage to the Quality Lead and Department Head, using agreed definitions and consistent data.
* Highlight quality trends and recurring defects, recommend improvements, and track agreed actions.

  

**Experience and Skills**

**Essential**

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in manual testing and test automation.
* Strong banking and fintech domain knowledge, with the ability to assess critical financial workflows, business rules, and transaction risks.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate release testing independently, manage regression priorities, and communicate release readiness and unresolved risks.
* Practical experience building and maintaining automated tests, investigating failures, and improving test coverage.
* Strong understanding of test design, defect management, requirements traceability, test environment readiness, and the software development lifecycle.
* Ability to translate functional requirements and acceptance criteria into comprehensive test scenarios and maintain an organised test repository.
* Ability to guide junior QA engineers, allocate work, review outputs, and provide constructive feedback.
* Ability to track and interpret QA metrics and use findings to improve testing effectiveness.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, ownership, and the ability to manage competing priorities with minimal supervision.
* Willingness and ability to travel within India and internationally, as required.

**Preferred**

* Experience working in a fast-paced, product-driven environment.
* Exposure to end-to-end QA ownership within Agile teams, including planning, execution, defect triage, and release readiness.
* Hands-on experience with Testsigma or comparable test automation platforms.
* Experience with API testing, SQL-based data validation, version control, or automated test execution in CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience coordinating QA activities when team members are supporting client engagements.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Release testing runs reliably, with clear ownership, ready environments, and timely escalation of blockers.
* Critical user journeys have effective manual and automated coverage, and test cases remain traceable to requirements.
* Quality metrics are accurate and actionable, with progress against agreed improvement targets.
* Junior QA engineers deliver consistent outputs with appropriate guidance and review.

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Description**

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.

You will be a senior testing leader within the Mondelēz International Digital & Technology organization, responsible for leading end-to-end quality assurance and testing activities across large-scale transformation programs, including the o9 Enterprise Operations Planning (EOP) platform rollout. You will own the testing strategy, manage testing cycles, and drive quality outcomes across multiple workstreams and regional stakeholders in the CPG industry.

**How you will contribute**

You will lead the test management function for o9 EOP and other large transformation programs, ensuring that quality is built into every stage of delivery. Working closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and platform vendors, you will define and execute a robust testing framework that covers functional, regression, integration, performance, and UAT testing. Specifically, you will:

* Define and own the end-to-end test strategy, test plans, and testing governance framework for large-scale ERP and planning transformation programs, including o9 Wave deployments across NALA, MEU, and AMEA.

* Lead and manage all testing phases including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Regression Testing, Performance Testing, and Go-Live readiness validation.

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks using Selenium and TOSCA, ensuring maximum test coverage and reusability across program cycles.

* Track and manage testing cycles end-to-end — including test case creation, defect logging, triage, resolution tracking, and exit criteria sign-off — using industry-standard test management tools.

* Manage relationships with multiple stakeholders including business leads, process owners, technical architects, and vendor teams, ensuring alignment on quality standards, timelines, and testing outcomes.

* Establish and maintain defect management processes, ensuring timely escalation, prioritization, and resolution of critical defects in collaboration with development and platform teams.

* Lead UAT exit approval processes, coordinating with business stakeholders to secure sign-offs and document test completion evidence for program governance.

* Drive continuous improvement in testing practices by introducing automation, optimizing test cycles, and reducing manual testing effort over time.

* Provide regular test status reporting to program leadership and key stakeholders, including metrics on test execution progress, defect trends, and risk indicators.

* Coach and mentor testing analysts and junior team members, fostering a quality-first culture across delivery teams.

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

* Leading quality assurance and testing workstreams for large-scale ERP, supply chain, or enterprise platform transformation programs in the CPG or FMCG industry.

* Hands-on expertise with test automation tools, specifically Selenium (for web-based UI automation) and TOSCA (Tricentis) for end-to-end test automation and continuous testing.

* Test management tools such as JIRA/Zephyr, ALM (HP Quality Center), Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms for managing test cases, cycles, and defect tracking.

* Designing and executing SIT, UAT, regression, and performance testing strategies for complex, multi-system landscapes including ERP (SAP), planning platforms (o9, IBP), and integrated non-SAP applications.

* Stakeholder management — communicating testing status, risks, and quality outcomes clearly to both technical teams and senior business leadership across multiple regions and functions.

* Driving UAT processes including test scenario design with business users, defect triage sessions, exit criteria definition, and formal sign-off procedures.

* Agile and waterfall delivery methodologies, with the ability to adapt testing approaches to program context.

* Working in global, matrixed organizations with geographically distributed teams and multiple vendor partners.

* Risk-based testing approaches — identifying critical test scenarios and prioritizing coverage based on business impact.

* Building and maintaining reusable test asset libraries that accelerate future testing cycles and regression runs.

**More about this role**

**What you need to know about this position:**

* This role is a key leadership position within the o9 EOP program and will support UAT, SIT, and Go-Live testing activities across all wave deployments.

* The Testing Lead will coordinate closely with the Solution Architect, Integration teams, Business Process Owners, and the o9 vendor team to ensure full end-to-end test coverage.

* The role requires strong organizational skills to manage parallel testing workstreams across multiple regions and business functions simultaneously.

* This position sits within the Digital & Technology function and reports into the o9 Program Leadership / Quality Assurance Lead.

**What extra ingredients you will bring:**

* Experience testing o9 Solutions, SAP IBP, SAP S/4HANA, or equivalent enterprise supply chain and planning platforms.

* Familiarity with supply chain planning processes — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP, Trade Promotion Management (TPM) — and the ability to translate business scenarios into effective test cases.

* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and Develops practices, with experience integrating automated tests into build and release pipelines.

* Exposure to AI-powered testing tools or intelligent test automation practices is a plus.

* Experience with data validation testing — including master data, transactional data, and integration payload verification across system boundaries.

**Education / Certifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. An engineering background is strongly preferred.

* ISTQB certification (Foundation, Advanced Test Manager, or Agile Tester) is highly desirable.

* Trecentist TOSCA certification (e.g., TOSCA Automation Specialist Level 1 or 2) is a strong advantage.

* SAP or o9 functional knowledge certifications are a plus.

* Project Management certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe) are beneficial given the stakeholder and program management scope of this role.

**Job specific requirements:**

* Minimum 8–10 years of experience in QA and software testing roles, with at least 4–5 years in a test lead or test manager capacity on large transformation programs.

* Proven track record of successfully leading UAT exit approvals and Go-Live readiness validations for enterprise platform programs.

* Demonstrated experience managing and reporting to senior stakeholders across business and IT in a global CPG or FMCG environment.

* Strong hands-on experience with both Selenium and TOSCA automation frameworks is mandatory.

description:

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

**Job Details**
===============

**Developer - Azure (Integrations, Data Factory, Function App, Logic App, Insights)**

**What you will be doing**

You'll build and run the Azure integration layer that connects Dynamics 365 to the rest of Cencora for the PRISM program. That means designing the message flows, writing the Functions and Logic Apps that move and transform data, defining the JSON contracts between systems, and keeping all of it healthy in production once it ships. You'll sit in the D365 Center of Excellence, work day to day with the PRISM delivery teams and our AMS partner, and own your integrations end to end: design, build, test, deploy, and support.

PRISM runs on a global ERP footprint across 25+ countries, so the integrations you build carry real order, finance, and compliance data at scale. Reliability, observability, and clean error handling matter more here than clever code.

**Primary duties and responsibilities**

* Design and build event-driven and batch integrations between Dynamics 365 F&O, Power Platform, and enterprise systems using Azure Service Bus (queues, topics, subscriptions, dead-lettering), Azure Function Apps, and Azure Logic Apps including JSON paramters/objects.
* Build and maintain Azure Data Factory and Synapse pipelines for data movement, transformation, and reconciliation, including batch loads, incremental loads, and data-quality checks.
* Define and govern JSON payload contracts and message schemas; version them, document them, and enforce them through validation at the integration boundary.
* Implement error handling, retry, idempotency, and dead-letter patterns; instrument integrations with Application Insights and Azure Monitor so failures are visible before the business reports them.
* Integrate with Power Platform components (Dataverse, Power Automate, model-driven and canvas apps) where PRISM processes span D365 and Power Apps.
* Own integrations through the full lifecycle in Azure DevOps: user stories, design, build, unit and integration testing, CI/CD deployment across Dev, QA, UAT, and Production, cutover, and hypercare.
* Support data conversion and migration activities: mock loads, technical validation, and reconciliation between source and target systems.
* Provide L3 support for production integrations, work root cause with Problem Management, and hold the AMS partner to agreed fixes and timelines.
* Write technical design documents, runbooks, and integration specifications that another engineer can pick up without a walkthrough.
* Review designs and code from other developers, including vendor teams, and push back when a design creates technical debt or won't scale.

**What should your background look like**

Experience and education

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years in software or integration engineering, with at least 2 years building production integrations on Azure.
* Delivered at least one enterprise ERP or CRM integration program end to end (design through go-live and hypercare). Dynamics 365 F&O or CE experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience working in a SAFe Agile or Scrum delivery model with Azure DevOps for backlog, pipelines, and release management.

Required technical skills

* Azure Service Bus: topics, subscriptions, sessions, dead-letter handling, message ordering, and duplicate detection.
* Azure Function Apps in C#/.NET (Python acceptable) including durable functions, triggers, bindings, and secure configuration through Key Vault and managed identities.
* Azure Logic Apps (Standard and Consumption), including custom connectors, B2B/EDI scenarios, and workflow error handling.
* Azure Data Factory and Synapse Pipelines: pipeline design, data flows, parameterization, triggers, and monitoring.
* JSON schema design, payload mapping and transformation, and REST/OData API development and consumption.
* SQL and Azure SQL Database, including performance tuning for high-volume integration and staging tables.
* Application Insights, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics (KQL) for diagnostics and alerting.
* Git-based source control, branching strategies, and CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.

Preferred skills

* Power Platform integration: Dataverse APIs, Power Automate cloud flows, custom connectors, and the Dataverse/D365 F&O dual-write and virtual entity patterns.
* Dynamics 365 F&O data entities, Data Management Framework (DMF), recurring integrations, and business events.
* Microsoft Fabric or Power BI for integration reporting and data lineage.
* Kingswaysoft or SSIS for migration and batch scenarios.
* Exposure to pharmaceutical distribution, healthcare, or other regulated environments where audit trails and data integrity are non-negotiable.
* Microsoft certifications such as AZ-204 (Azure Developer), AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect), DP-203 (Data Engineering), or PL-400 (Power Platform Developer).

**How you work**

* You explain technical trade-offs to product owners and business analysts in plain language and don't hide behind jargon.
* You document as you build, not after.
* You're comfortable working across time zones with US-based stakeholders and a distributed delivery team, including some overlap with US Eastern hours for design sessions and cutovers.
* You treat production support as part of engineering, not someone else's problem.
